title: Segment at length
blurb: Scrubs distance along a multi-segment path to compare native getPathSegmentAtLength() against the cumulative getTotalLength() workaround, including clamping, boundary, NaN, and empty-path edges.
question: Does getPathSegmentAtLength() match cumulative-length hit-testing across subpaths and clamp out-of-range or empty-path inputs per the SVG Paths specification?
result: Chrome 158 with SVGPathDataAPI: native getPathSegmentAtLength() matched the cumulative-length workaround across both shapes; negative distance clamps to the first command, over-length to the last, an exact boundary returns the earlier segment, NaN throws TypeError and an empty path returns null. Default-on Chrome 160 not verified.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (Linux, headless) with --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI on 2026-11-25; Chrome 153 behind the same flag lacked the method
